purpose: Clarify the already-required random-anchor stress diagnostic without changing the frozen primary population, systems, fitting, selection, acceptance, safety, or authority.

resolution.algorithm: Strictly parse the exact parent after receipt verification, resolve the RFC 6901 parent_object_pointer, require the member to be absent, add exactly the declared member/value pair, and reject any other operation or mutation.

value.inner_membership: No deterministic_random_anchor_stress episode, anchor context, query truth, prediction, or loss enters any inner cell, hyperparameter selection, categorical vocabulary, scaler, hierarchy fit, or score-free token.
value.outer_membership: For each repeat and outer fold, outer model and scorer capabilities include every query row of every deterministic_random_anchor_stress public episode whose frozen proxy family is assigned to that repeat and outer fold. Membership and order are derived only from public episodes, masks, structures, and folds; selector and query availability never determine row presence.
value.model_context: Each outer stress episode exposes only its one R2 mask-designated anchor CYP3A4 context under the same measured-potency and C3 capability separation as selected-anchor episodes. Every non-anchor label in its held-out family remains excluded.
value.hyperparameters: Every stress prediction reuses the already selected score-free hyperparameters for the matching system, repeat, and outer fold. Stress cannot fit, tune, select, calibrate, or alter a candidate.
value.sealed_scoring: The outer sealed scorer may filter stress rows to selector_cyp_truth==CYP3A4 and finite query truth and may emit selected-versus-random-anchor diagnostic facts only.
value.non_authority: Stress rows, predictions, losses, slices, and comparisons cannot enter primary support, required contrasts, cell-direction criteria, influence ranking, safety fusion, pass/fail criteria, status resolution, or rescue a failed selected-anchor result.

resolution.effective_contract: The verified v1 parent plus the one ordered absent-member addition above. V1 remains immutable history and every unmentioned scientific, schema, runtime, firewall, output, accounting, and authority rule is unchanged.
resolution.failure: Missing or changed parent bytes, a missing/non-object pointer target, a preexisting member, an unknown operation, or any additional mutation is a contract-integrity failure before R5B implementation acceptance.

reversal_condition: Any stress-row influence on inner selection, primary support, required contrasts, safety fusion, acceptance, or status revokes this clarification and keeps numeric official targets closed.
